ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; approximately 85% low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the medial and proximal regions vs 15% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs are mapped to the distal margins of both the left and right lobes. The central and proximal fluke areas consist of a uniform, low-intensity dark mass with no significant interior mottling visible.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible shallow V-shaped depression at the center; the angle is obtuse, approximately 130-140 degrees, with a notch depth estimated at 10% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations with a frequency of approximately 10-12 peaks per lobe; pixel-amplitude of variations is higher on the right lobe trailing edge compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes follow a convex mathematical curve along the trailing edge, converging into sharp, acute-angled points at the distal extremities.
